description: This Java class defines the response object for a 'ModifyFeature' command in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It handles creating, parsing, and representing the response related to feature modifications on a thing, including serialization and deserialization from JSON, and maintaining relevant identifiers and status codes.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureResponse
classes.description: Represents the response to a 'ModifyFeature' command, encapsulating details such as the related thing ID, the feature created or modified, and the HTTP status code. Supports serialization from and to JSON, and maintains response metadata.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Factory method for creating a response indicating a feature has been created, with an HTTP 201 status.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Factory method for creating a response indicating a feature has been modified, with an HTTP 204 status.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a ModifyFeatureResponse instance.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the thing associated with this response.

methods.name: getFeatureCreated
methods.description: Returns the created or modified feature, if present.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the feature as JSON according to a specific schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer to the resource, specifically the feature's path.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Adds the response payload to a JSON object builder, respecting schema version and predicate conditions.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on thing ID, feature, status code, and superclass properties.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on internal fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the response object.
